subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Which open fix branch should be treated as canonical for this issue's dispatcher plus Telegram streamed-final `message_sending` repair?
rationale: Current main still has the bug and several open PRs overlap; automation should not create another fix or choose between dispatcher-only and exactly-once Telegram ownership designs without maintainer intent.

options.title: Select the broad exactly-once branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as canonical if maintainers want the dispatcher seam and Telegram streamed-final gap fixed together, then require rebase, ready-for-review state, and final proof.

options.title: Select a narrow dispatcher-first branch
options.body: Use a smaller PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/92762 only if maintainers intentionally defer Telegram preview-finalized coverage to a separate tracked follow-up.

options.title: Request a replacement branch
options.body: Ask for a fresh focused branch if none of the open implementations has the right hook ownership boundary or proof shape.

recommendation.title: Select the broad exactly-once branch
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93216 as canonical if maintainers want the dispatcher seam and Telegram streamed-final gap fixed together, then require rebase, ready-for-review state, and final proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal points to the current dispatcher hook-composition change and tests that define the conflicted seam.
